title: CogRec: Structure-Cognitive Fast-and-Slow Reasoning for Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2607.24402v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative recommendation reformulates next-item prediction as identifier sequence generation, yet existing methods mainly treat the generated identifiers as target sequences to be memorized, leaving their hierarchical and relational structure underused for explicit reasoning. We propose CogRec, a structure-cognitive fast-and-slow reasoning framework that grounds intermediate reasoning in the same SID topology used for target generation. CogRec augments the vertical SID hierarchy with intra-layer semantic graphs and introduces SID Routing to represent recommendation reasoning through layer-wise Match, LateralJump, and Explore operations. These operations provide a structural interpretation of fast localization and slow navigation. A supervised multi-stage pipeline aligns newly introduced SID tokens, establishes direct generation, and trains natural-language and SID Routing branches from a shared checkpoint. Experiments on three Amazo

translated_title: CogRec：面向生成式推荐的结构认知快慢推理框架
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐将下一项预测重新表述为标识符序列生成任务，然而现有方法主要将生成的标识符视为需要记忆的目标序列，未能充分利用其层次结构与关系结构来进行显式推理。我们提出了CogRec，一个结构认知的快慢推理框架，它将中间推理过程锚定在与目标生成相同的SID（语义标识符）拓扑结构上。CogRec在垂直SID层次结构的基础上引入了层内语义图，并提出SID Routing机制，通过逐层的匹配、横向跳跃和探索操作来表征推荐推理过程，这些操作为“快速定位”与“慢速导航”提供了结构化解释。一个有监督的多阶段流水线负责对齐新引入的SID标记、建立直接生成能力，并从共享检查点出发训练自然语言与SID Routing两个分支。在三个亚马逊数据集上的实验……
tldr: 提出CogRec框架，通过SID Routing的匹配、横向跳跃和探索操作将中间推理过程锚定在SID层次拓扑结构上，实现了生成式推荐中基于结构的快慢显式推理。
en_tdlr: CogRec is a structure-cognitive fast-and-slow reasoning framework for generative recommendation that grounds intermediate reasoning in the SID topology via SID Routing's Match, LateralJump, and Explore operations for explicit structural reasoning.
